recorded: 2026-09-05, during run 6, BEFORE any actor update in run 6
status: MEASURED DISCREPANCY between the two evaluation paths on an IDENTICAL policy. Cause under investigation. Amends how the in-trainer H4 rule is read; the scorer-of-record rule is unchanged.

measurement.policy: run 6's first checkpoint at 15,480 env steps: ~100 gradient updates, all critic-only (actor_updated=False), deployed action error on ep046 = 0.403 deg = the BC checkpoint exactly. The policy is bit-identical to BC.
measurement.why_this_is_not_noise: BC grasped 37/37 across two independent processes; 19/25 under the same predicate is a different rate, not the documented post-grasp nondeterminism (which affects lift/carry, and left grasp at 25/25 in the 8-run study).

what_was_wrongly_assumed: After run 4, the in-trainer evaluation and eval_checkpoint.py were said to agree because both scored 0.00. That equivalence was only ever checked on a collapsed policy, where both are trivially zero. On a working policy the in-trainer path scores lower.

consequence_for_the_pre_registered_rules.H4_in_trainer: The 0.87 threshold was derived from the scorer of record's CI and would FAIL a perfectly preserved policy on the in-trainer path (0.76 < 0.87). The in-trainer periodic evals are therefore read RELATIVE TO THEIR OWN BASELINE of 0.76 measured here on the unchanged policy: a fall well below 0.76 (e.g. below 0.5) indicates regression; values near 0.76 indicate preservation. This is an amendment justified by a measurement of the unchanged policy, made before the intervention has acted.
consequence_for_the_pre_registered_rules.H4_scorer_of_record: UNCHANGED: eval_checkpoint.py, n=25 deterministic, grasp >= 0.87. This is the number of record for both arms.
consequence_for_the_pre_registered_rules.H6_H8: Unchanged; they are measured through the deployment path, not through either evaluation loop.

candidate_causes_to_check: simulator state carried over from ~18 noisy training episodes before the periodic eval (env.reset(seed=0) may not fully reset articulation/contact state)
a difference in the rollout loop between _rollout and eval_checkpoint.evaluate (termination handling, chunk count, reward object reuse)
the periodic suite prefix vs the scorer's suite (same seed and first 25 conditions must be confirmed)
does_not_affect: The BC result (scored by the scorer of record), the videos, or the entropy mean-force finding.
